purpose: Freeze the comparison design before any formal Stage 09 VCS run.

common_design.coverage_update: Union only newly completed run vectors; a failed run contributes no bins.
common_design.completion_order: Use actual completion timestamps; do not reorder asynchronous feedback by submission id.

no_incremental_refill.label: No Incremental Refill
no_incremental_refill.change: Wait for all ten jobs in a logical batch before selecting the next batch.

no_runtime_penalty.label: No Runtime Penalty
no_runtime_penalty.change: Set alpha_min=alpha_max=0 while retaining all coverage and UCB terms.

random_selection.label: Random Selection
random_selection.change: Uniformly sample one of the 17 candidate jobs with replacement; ignore cluster and feedback scores.

sequence_ucb_only.label: Sequence UCB Only
sequence_ucb_only.change: Remove explicit target-cluster selection; choose a job with sequence-level UCB over the full candidate set.

cluster_ucb_only.label: Cluster UCB Only
cluster_ucb_only.change: Keep target-cluster UCB but choose a candidate job uniformly from the target-relevant set; remove sequence UCB and runtime penalty.

failure_policy.timeout: record as failed with timeout reason and retain any measured runtime
failure_policy.missing_vector: failed; never infer coverage from logs
failure_policy.schema_mismatch: abort the method and invalidate its run directory

reasons: Stage 08 smoke used project fixed seed 42 and did not apply the scheduler-derived seed.
Only one live VCS worker has been verified; ten concurrent license seats are not yet verified.
A formal result must use a fresh server run root and must not reuse Stage 06 vectors or Stage 07 replay events.
required_before_formal_run: Apply and record the per-submission derived seed in the VCS command and vector metadata.
Run a fresh seed-handoff smoke and independently verify the seed in the generated VDB/XML metadata.
Verify the requested worker/queue behavior without changing the coverage schema.
Create a new server run id and export only sanitized vectors, manifests, status and hashes.

prohibited_reuse: 06_初始语料与bin矩阵/evidence/public_20261101_initial/bin_by_run.tsv as formal Stage 09 adaptive results
07_覆盖聚类与UCB调度/evidence/public_20261101_stage07/dryrun as formal VCS results
